mapper.select: SELECT t1.CORP_GR , t1.FUND_CD , t1.SEQ_NO , t1.AEKM , t1.TR_AEK , CASE WHEN t1.AEKM > 0 THEN t1.TR_AEK / t1.AEKM * 10000 ELSE 0 END AS danga , t1.TR_YMD , t1.TR_CD , t1.JM_CD AS hj_cd , hj.HJ_NM AS xx_hj_cd , t1.TR_CO_CD , t1.MK_SUIK_RT , t1.SANGHW_AEK , t1.SUSU_GA , t1.TAX_OFFER_GB , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , t1.JAJUN_GB , t1.SUNG_COST , t1.AUTO_PER , t1.SUSU_09900 , t1.SUNSU_IJA , 1 AS p_visible FROM SHT0HG t1 LEFT JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD JOIN SHM0HJ hj ON hj.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND hj.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_YMD = #{trYmd} AND t1.TR_CD = 'J32' ORDER BY t1.FUND_CD
